description:
Step 3 of zaq-rft. See parent for authoritative shared fixture schema, paths, corpus design and reuse assessment. Related feature: zaq-4mu.

Use the configured multilingual embedding model in the development database. Confirm its dimension is supported by the existing pgvector table/index setup before making paid/network calls. Record the actual model and dimension; do not pad, truncate or recreate a populated production chunk table to accommodate fixtures.

Generate vectors, independently calculate query/chunk cosine distances after halfvec quantization, and review ranges and distractors. Use tight, justified numeric tolerances rather than `[0, 2]` assertions. Record the fixed evaluation threshold and fusion/context settings in each question or a shared test default with explicit per-question overrides; the embedding task never adjusts them.

Keep the provisional production threshold distinct from the fixture's deliberately pinned evaluation settings. Commit completed vectors and reviewed expectations before enabling the test in CI. If the configured model is unsuitable or unavailable, this step is a visible blocker, not permission to skip missing vectors.

Action reuse assessment: reuse SearchKnowledgeBase/Jido.Exec, NodeRouter and Embedding.Client as described in the parent. Fixture parsing and file updates are local-only developer tooling; no new agent tools or production retrieval behavior. Read applicable AGENTS.md policies before implementation. Do not skip missing vectors or weaken relevance assertions.

comments.text: Configured dev embedding model bge-multilingual-gemma2 dimension 3584 generated 42 distinct real vectors into 4 doc + 10 question JSON; no provider errors. Independently computed raw cosine over stored vectors: target distances english rail .3480, French monitor .2776, Arabic notice .2989, French keyboard .3638, English hotel .3363, English deadline .1904, mixed account .1540, mixed badge .2754. Reviewed ranges ±.020. Evaluation-specific threshold must be .45: unrelated-weather closest .5886 (> threshold); lexical-minibar semantic-to-hotel .6686 (> threshold), so lexical-only target possible. Production .75 remains separate. Measured in JS from fixtures without executing retrieval; halfvec/SQL verification remains pending.

Independently calculated target cosine ranges ±0.02 from 3584-dimensional stored vectors and reviewed all 11 question expectations. Added mixed Arabic orientation variant (target distance .2006). Evaluation threshold .45 keeps unrelated-negative nearest .5886 out and lexical-only minibar-to-hotel semantic distance .6686 out; production default remains separate. Native and ParadeDB integration checks passed for all 11 questions. Uncommitted pending landing authorization.
